title: The kept USP theme reaches the brief, its hero heading and the demo QA
steps: S1: Run the domain-brief-usp-theme test file of packages/wo/website-opportunities.
S2: Run the collected-used tests of apps/tracy-host/test/demo-qa.test.mjs and the agent demo test file of apps/tracy-web.
expect: S1: every test reports ok: brief.reading.uspThemes keeps the kept theme with basis one-review and its review quote, uspThemesDropped records why; no themes gives no key; the hero section's usp line is the theme line with its quotes only, in the acceptance list, brief_md and the agent prompt; a theme failing checkUspTheme is not the hero; a held review's quote leaves the theme.
S2: every test reports ok: collected-used reports what usp when home does not show the statement; the agent demo steps and collected usp carry the line, and a brief without one asks for none.
evidence: On dev the reading on the place profile carried a one-review USP theme with a verbatim Google review quote, but briefReading copied no uspThemes and hero-usp.mjs had no caller outside the domain folder, so neither the stored brief nor the hero copy carried it
fence: briefReading copying uspThemes, heroUspOf choosing the hero usp through checkUspTheme and findUsp, and checkCollectedUsed requiring the usp on home

tests: the brief carries the kept USP theme with its rung and quotes, and the dropped ones with why
a reading without USP themes gives no uspThemes key; the hero falls back to a theme read in code
the hero says the kept theme line, rests on its quotes only, and the brief and prompt ask for it
a theme that fails the USP gate is not the hero: its quote must be in a review the site may show
a USP theme drops the quote of a review that names someone held off the site, and goes when none is left
collected-used: home shows the brief’s USP statement; on another page only, it is not shown
the brief’s hero USP statement reaches the agent’s steps and the collected-used check, word for word
